content.class.runner.blurb: 关卡一关得太久，收费公司就会派个跑腿的来。今年轮到你：找到看守的钥匙，把路重新打通。
content.class.runner.kit.0.name: 跑腿人的剑
content.class.runner.kit.1.name: 跑腿人的靴子
content.class.runner.name: 收费跑腿人
content.fx.sc.toll-door.1.narrate: 门闩滑开了。回院子的过道，如今只隔一扇门。
content.fx.the-key.oc.take-the-key.5.narrate: 钥匙拧开了车道的锁。石阶旁那座壁炉里的余烬熄了，炉背转开，后面露出旧车道的入口，和石阶一样宽。上面看守走道里的活板门也落开了。
content.fx.trig.the-shut-yard.0.narrate: 自从那场洪水，收费院就一直关着。通往内院的拱门被铁栏封着，收费房的门从里头闩上了，看守的活板门也锁着。看守把钥匙留在了过道尽头的箱子里。
content.fx.trig.toll-door-wrong-side.0.narrate: 这扇门是从收费房那一侧闩上的。
content.obj.the-key.take-the-key.hint: 穿过院子侧墙上的门洞。箱子在过道尽头，就在那扇闩上的门旁边。
content.obj.the-key.take-the-key.title: 取看守的钥匙
content.obj.the-way-through.enter-the-court.hint: 封着铁栏的拱门在院子另一头，与石阶相对。拉开收费房门的门闩，就能抄近路回去。
content.obj.the-way-through.pull-the-lever.hint: 沿车道走到尽头。拉杆在收费房的地上，靠着墙。
content.obj.the-way-through.pull-the-lever.title: 拉动收费房里的拉杆
content.quest.the-key.goal: 来到关闭的收费院，在过道尽头、那扇闩上的收费房门旁的箱子里找到看守的钥匙，用它打开院中壁炉后面的旧车道。
content.quest.the-way-through.goal: 沿车道走到收费房，拉动升起院中拱门铁栏的拉杆，拉开收费房门的门闩，再穿过拱门进入内院。
content.world.outro: 拱门在你身后敞开，收费院又成了一条通路。
content.world.title: 三道封路

source.class.runner.blurb: The toll company sends a runner when a yard is shut too long. This season it is you: find the keeper's key and open the way through.
source.class.runner.kit.0.name: Runner's sword
source.class.runner.kit.1.name: Runner's boots
source.class.runner.name: Toll Runner
source.fx.sc.toll-door.1.narrate: The bolt slides back. The passage to the yard is one door away now.
source.fx.the-key.oc.take-the-key.5.narrate: The key turns the cart road's lock. The embers go out on the yard's fireplace beside the stair, its fireback swings away, and the old road's mouth stands open behind it, as wide as the stair. Up on the keeper's walk, the hatch has fallen open too.
source.fx.trig.the-shut-yard.0.narrate: The toll yard has been shut since the floods. The arch to the court is barred, the toll house door is bolted from its own side, and the keeper's hatch is locked. The keeper left the key in the chest at the end of the passage.
source.fx.trig.toll-door-wrong-side.0.narrate: The door is bolted from the toll house side.
source.obj.the-key.take-the-key.hint: Go through the doorway in the yard's side wall. The chest is at the end of the passage, beside the bolted door.
source.obj.the-key.take-the-key.title: Take the keeper's key
source.obj.the-way-through.enter-the-court.hint: The barred arch is across the yard from the stair. Draw the bolt of the toll house door to go back by the short way.
source.obj.the-way-through.enter-the-court.titl: Go through the arch into the court
source.obj.the-way-through.pull-the-lever.hint: Walk the cart road to its end. The lever is on the toll house floor, by the wall.
source.obj.the-way-through.pull-the-lever.title: Pull the lever in the toll house
source.quest.the-key.goal: Arrive in the shut toll yard, find the keeper's key in the chest at the end of the passage, beside the bolted toll house door, and with it open the old cart road behind the yard's fireplace.
source.quest.the-way-through.goal: Walk the cart road to the toll house, pull the lever that raises the bars on the yard's arch, draw the bolt of the toll house door, and go through the arch into the inner court.
source.world.outro: The arch stands open behind you, and the toll yard is a way through again.
source.world.title: Three Ways Shut
